userEvidence: 핵심 주요 내용마다 영상한개씩은 그러면 영상마다 3개이상은 들어가줘야지 이해가 돼지
어떤영상은 잘들어갔는데 어떤영상은 안들어갔고 어떤영상은 너무 빠르게 넘어가서 짧고 그래 다 검수해서 만들어줘봐
설명쪽은 잘 된거같아 실제 게임 영상만 잘 삽입하고 기즈모그려서 표현해서 매끄럽게 잘 연결되게끔 해줘
scope: 18 selected existing Game Math lectures: preserve explanation scenes, formulas, voice and teaching order; fix actual gameplay selection, meaningful exposure, guides and joins.
stopAt: 18 revised four-file local deliveries and truthful internal QA, then human review

choice.interpretation: Three distinct taught examples/intervals, not a requirement to pad with three different titles. Each main concept needs a matched example; three alone is not a coverage pass.
choice.duration: Before/action/result and associated narration determine length. No automatic short window, looping, slowdown, or unrelated lead/tail padding.
choice.preserved: Existing explanation animation and speech. If a game-specific spoken fact cannot be matched, record it before changing narration; no automatic new TTS.
choice.stillFrames: An explicitly labeled analytical freeze can support a moving demonstration; it is explanation time, never counted as additional actual gameplay.
